on_failure:
from sqlbuild.orchestration import NodeEventKind, job, node_event, schedule, sensor
annual_orders = job('annual_orders', select='orders', description='Build orders.', schedule=schedule(cron='0 0 1 1 *', timezone='UTC', starts_at='2000-01-01T00:00:00Z'))
refresh_inventory = job('refresh_inventory', select='inventory', description='Refresh inventory.')
failed_orders = sensor('failed_orders', description='React to an actual orders check failure.', when=node_event(select='check:orders_valid', kinds=[NodeEventKind.FAILED]), run=refresh_inventory, minimum_interval_seconds=1)
inventory:
MODEL (description 'Inventory after check failure.', materialized table);
SELECT 59 AS amount;
